messages.content: I’m ready to finish Columbus. Before you charge anything, reconcile the dates and the final numbers. I have Sunday December 9 through Tuesday December 11, the $239 hotel across from the office, and the $512 nonstops.

That is two hotel nights: Sunday, December 9 and Monday, December 10, with checkout Tuesday, December 11. The room total is about $562 after tax. Adding $512 airfare and an estimated $68 for airport rideshares produces a projected trip total of $1,142. The airfare quote expires tonight at midnight.
And the cancellation deadline on the room? Also make sure the late arrival and Tuesday luggage plan are included.

The refundable room can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time on Friday, December 7, two days before arrival. After that, the quoted penalty is one night plus tax. I’ll note an expected Sunday check-in at about 8:45 p.m. and request luggage storage after Tuesday checkout until you leave the office.
Good. Ticket the flights first at $512, then reserve that room. No checked bag.

The nonstop round trip is ticketed at $512: Sunday, December 9, MSP 5:10 p.m. to CMH 8:03 p.m.; Tuesday, December 11, CMH 6:35 p.m. to MSP 7:42 p.m. No checked bag was added. The hotel reservation is also confirmed for two nights at approximately $562 after tax, with the 8:45 p.m. arrival notation and post-checkout luggage request attached.
Give me the Tuesday airport timing. Meetings may run until 4:10.

Check out Tuesday morning, leave the bag with the hotel, and retrieve it immediately after meetings. Request the rideshare as the meeting ends and leave the Easton area by 4:15 p.m. The estimated drive should put you at CMH around 4:35-4:50 p.m., leaving roughly 1 hour 45 minutes before the 6:35 p.m. departure.
Now put everything in one final confirmed itinerary, including what is still only estimated.

Confirmed Columbus itinerary: Sunday, December 9, fly nonstop MSP-CMH from 5:10 p.m. to 8:03 p.m., then rideshare to the hotel across from the client office. Expected check-in is noted for 8:45 p.m. Stay Sunday and Monday nights and check out Tuesday, December 11. The room is refundable until Friday, December 7 at 6:00 p.m. local time; afterward the quoted penalty is one night plus tax. Tuesday, store your luggage after checkout, attend meetings, retrieve the bag when they end around 4:10 p.m., and depart for CMH by 4:15 p.m. Fly nonstop CMH-MSP from 6:35 p.m. to 7:42 p.m. Confirmed charges are $512 airfare and approximately $562 lodging. Airport rideshares remain unbooked and are estimated at $68, making the projected trip total $1,142; tips, surge pricing, meals, and other incidentals are excluded.
